requirements.statement: Five-year storage at twice the accepted peak fits 16 GiB.
Expired run detail is summarised atomically while live authority and learning remain.
Retention is bounded owner-thread maintenance and cannot block work.
Swept detail has a plain historical answer and stored vocabulary remains readable.
Retention summaries survive backup, upgrade, source imaging and transfer.

Retention indexes are created inside the consented records-upgrade step (the ledger 17->18 open of --upgrade-ledger, and the B4t takeover adoption) on every path that performs it; a plain or unconsented open creates none; registration with a running collector leaves them in place (decision 349).
